input.fields: object of arrays of integral u8; missing or nonexact length is incomplete
input.arguments: optional object; variant required only for mixer request; unknown keys preserved
input.kinds: no coercion; Boolean is not integer
input.context-presence: missing, null, zero remain distinct; absent/null selectors are unsupported; opaque kinds unchanged

result.copy: context, raw, arguments and field raw are independent; no shared mutable storage across calls
result.partial: nonexact field length; complete independent siblings survive
result.incomplete: state=incomplete; raw omitted only when input field absent; no number or label
result.unmapped: state=Unknown; raw retained; no invented number or label
